cards.title: Crusoe Sells Wyoming Data Center to Google
cards.body: Crusoe has divested its troubled Wyoming data center project to Google. The deal underscores the significant challenges in developing massive AI infrastructure.

cards.title: OpenAI Raises $11B at $1.25T Valuation
cards.body: OpenAI has secured an additional $11 billion in funding as part of an ongoing round expected to close in coming weeks. The raise values the company at $1.25 trillion.

cards.title: Artex AI Hacking Tools Publicly Exposed
cards.body: Hundreds of servers hosting the Artex penetration testing tool were left exposed to the internet. Security researchers discovered anyone could access the AI hacking tool.

cards.title: Meta Launches Spaces for Muse Agents
cards.body: Meta introduced Spaces, a new collaboration feature for its Muse AI agents. The platform offers fresh ways to interact with AI helpers.

cards.title: Midterm Victories Could Reshape AI Industry
cards.body: Democrats' election sweep could transform tech policy, particularly around data center development. Voters approved restrictions on data centers in 40 of 41 ballot measures.

cards.title: AI Industry Faces Rough Two Years Ahead
cards.body: Political backlash from midterm results threatens AI expansion plans across the industry. Data center restrictions could reshape infrastructure investments.

cards.title: AI Spending Stalls as Anthropic Eyes IPO
cards.body: Ramp data shows AI usage climbing but spending has plateaued. Price cuts and better cost controls among major spenders challenge hypergrowth assumptions.

cards.title: Amazon Enables Text-Based Shopping with Alexa
cards.body: Amazon now lets users text Alexa for shopping assistance. The feature rolls out to millions in coming weeks.

cards.title: Underdog Demos 32MB Speech Generation Model
cards.body: Underdog unveiled a remarkably compact 32MB model capable of generating speech and music. The tiny model challenges assumptions about AI size requirements.

cards.title: Physicl Raises $10M for Robot Simulation
cards.body: Physicl secured $10 million to bridge the sim-to-real gap for robotics. The startup leverages a pipeline originally designed for online retail.

cards.title: Palo Alto Networks in Talks for Clutch Acquisition
cards.body: Palo Alto Networks is negotiating to acquire AI agent security startup Clutch for $500 million. Clutch was previously valued at $85 million.

cards.title: Airbnb Launching AI Travel Agent in 2027
cards.body: Airbnb announced an AI travel agent coming in the first half of 2027. The agent will help plan trips, compare options, and manage bookings.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Now Available for Video Calls
cards.body: US users can video chat with Meta's customizable Muse AI avatar. The feature precedes a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.

cards.title: Meta Warns of Data Center Political Backlash
cards.body: Meta cautioned that growing political opposition to data centers threatens future AI investments. Communities are increasingly pushing back against massive infrastructure projects.

cards.title: OpenAI Releases Cybersecurity AI Model
cards.body: OpenAI launched a new cybersecurity model amid industry scrutiny over AI infrastructure protection. The release addresses growing concerns about digital security threats.

cards.title: OpenAI President Says IPO Possible in 2027
cards.body: OpenAI president Greg Brockman stated the company could be IPO-ready by 2027. He highlighted enterprise market gains against rival Anthropic.

cards.title: Claude Adds Personal Finance Analysis Tool
cards.body: Anthropic's Claude can now analyze spending through a new Personal Finance tool. Users connect bank and card accounts via Plaid to ask financial questions.

cards.title: Axiom Math Fights AI Slop with Verification
cards.body: Axiom Math launched AI agents that formally verify mathematical proofs to combat unchecked AI errors. The startup's agents just verified the Stacks Project library.

cards.title: Dropbox Acquires Tigris Data for $350M
cards.body: Dropbox acquired Tigris Data for $350 million to strengthen AI infrastructure capabilities. The deal supports DBX Agent Cloud, a new storage platform for AI developers.

cards.title: Aina's Smart Ring Controls AI Agents
cards.body: Aina unveiled a smart ring featuring a screen, joystick, and microphone for AI interaction. The device also handles calls and Mac note dictation.

cards.title: Humanoid Robot Cleaning Service Launches in San Francisco
cards.body: A new humanoid robot cleaning service is operating in San Francisco, offering a glimpse into the future of AI-powered domestic automation. The technology demonstrates practical applications of robotics beyond theoretical research.

cards.title: Texas AI Data Center Boom at Risk After Elections
cards.body: Texas has been the fastest-growing data center market in the US and ground zero for major AI buildouts by Big Tech. Recent political shifts may jeopardize the state's position as an AI infrastructure hub.

cards.title: Reverse Game Theory Could Control Powerful AI Agents
cards.body: A new approach called "reverse game theory" aims to control powerful AI models by designing systems that keep agents in check. This emerging technique addresses critical safety concerns for enterprise AI deployment.

cards.title: Securing Enterprise AI Agents With Data Lineage
cards.body: Data lineage becomes critical when multiple AI agents pull information from restricted systems and internal sources to generate outputs. Proper security protocols are essential to prevent inaccurate or unauthorized information flow in agentic systems.

cards.title: Nvidia CEO Summoned by Congress Over Chinese Espionage
cards.body: Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang has been called to testify before Congress regarding concerns about Chinese espionage and AI chip technology. The hearing reflects growing scrutiny over AI hardware security and export controls.

cards.title: NASA Unveils X-70 Experimental Aircraft Using AI
cards.body: NASA has revealed the mysterious X-70 experimental aircraft, which was unveiled using an AI-generated image. The project showcases AI's role in aerospace innovation and visualization.
